title: Fires in the Built Environment and Residential Market Demand
abstract: Using nationwide data on multifamily residential transactions in South Korea, we investigate how large-scale fires in the built environment affect housing markets. We make use of geo-spatial data and apply the difference-in-differences research design to show that fires within an apartment complex cause an approximately 9 percent decline in housing prices over a 1-2 month-long period. In contrast, fires that occur slightly farther away or in non-residential buildings have no significant effect. Text mining analysis further suggests that greater media coverage—often associated with fires in nonresidential structures—does not necessarily result in larger price declines.
abstract_zh: 利用韩国多户住宅交易的全国性数据，我们考察了建成环境中的大规模火灾如何影响住房市场。我们利用地理空间数据，并应用双重差分研究设计，表明公寓小区内的火灾会在1至2个月的时间内导致房价下降约9%。相比之下，发生在稍远处或非住宅建筑中的火灾则没有显著影响。文本挖掘分析进一步表明，通常与非住宅建筑火灾相关的更多媒体报道，并不一定导致更大的房价下跌。

title: Rising Operational Costs from Power Outages: Implications for Hydropower
The Sources of Researcher Variation in Economics
Bridging the Rural Divide: The Impact of Broadband Grants on U.S. Agriculture
abstract: Since 2002, the Community Connect Grants (CCG) Program has provided financial assistance to provide broadband service in rural, economically challenged communities where service does not exist. We employ the event study model to show that a zip code receiving the grant experiences a 9.3 per cent increase in crop productivity after three years. This positive effect is predominantly driven by low-income areas that see a consistently positive increase in crop productivity, ranging from 6.3 to 13.8 per cent. Our findings conclude that policies designed to expand high-speed broadband infrastructure in rural areas can further develop the agricultural sector through gains in productivity.
abstract_zh: 自2002年以来，社区连接补助（Community Connect Grants，CCG）项目为经济困难的农村社区提供财政援助，以建设原本没有服务的宽带服务。我们采用事件研究模型表明，获得补助的邮政编码区在三年后作物生产率提高了9.3%。这一正向效应主要由低收入地区推动，这些地区的作物生产率持续提高，增幅在6.3%至13.8%之间。我们的研究结论是，旨在扩大农村高速宽带基础设施的政策，可以通过生产率的提高进一步促进农业部门的发展。

title: Economic Impact of Large Earthquakes: Lessons from Residential Property Values
Effects of Natural Disasters on Human Capital
abstract: The extent to which natural disasters influence changes in human capital and productivity remains an open empirical question with significant policy implications. This article provides a systematic review of econometric studies examining the economic impacts of natural disasters on human capital over the past 10 to 15 years. It concentrates exclusively on quantitative studies with both macro-level and micro-level economic analyses that emphasize causal inference and offer valuable insights for policy makers. Macro-level evidence on the economic impact of natural disasters focuses on economic growth, which has direct repercussions on changes in human capital. Micro-level empirical evidence highlights new findings on how natural disasters affect educational attainment and physical health outcomes. The article also discusses key limitations of existing studies and offers directions for future research.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害对人力资本和生产率变化的影响程度，仍是一个具有重大政策意义的开放性实证问题。本文对过去10至15年间考察自然灾害对人力资本经济影响的计量经济学研究进行了系统综述。文章专门聚焦于同时包含宏观和微观经济分析、强调因果推断并能为政策制定者提供有价值洞见的定量研究。关于自然灾害经济影响的宏观层面证据，主要关注经济增长，而经济增长会直接影响人力资本的变化。微观层面的实证证据则揭示了自然灾害如何影响教育程度和身体健康结果的新发现。文章还讨论了现有研究的主要局限，并提出了未来研究的方向。

title: Fertile Grounds: Navigating the Environmental Impact of Fertilizer Consumption
abstract: This article takes advantage of the economic geography of fertilizer production to show that a 10 per cent increase in the use of fertilizers is associated with a 3.09 per cent increase in agricultural nitrous oxide emissions over a 15-year long period from 2006 to 2020, and a 15.28 per cent increase in water withdrawals for agricultural purposes. Findings further indicate that the effects of fertilizer consumption on crop water footprints and agricultural methane emissions are not statistically distinguishable from zero. A back-of-the-envelope calculation reveals that these fertilizer-induced environmental externalities lead to approximately 15,450 annual deaths worldwide through nitrous oxide emissions.
abstract_zh: 本文利用化肥生产的经济地理格局，表明在2006年至2020年的15年期间，化肥使用量每增加10%，农业氧化亚氮排放量相应增加3.09%，农业取水量增加15.28%。研究结果进一步表明，化肥消费对作物水足迹和农业甲烷排放的影响，在统计上与零无显著差异。粗略的估算显示，这些化肥引起的环境外部性，通过氧化亚氮排放，每年在全球导致约15,450例死亡。

title: Natural Disasters and Land Use Dynamics: Evidence from Earthquake-Induced Deforestation
Picking up the PACE: A Multi-state Empirical Analysis of Payments for Agricultural Conservation Easement (PACE) Program Performance
abstract: The United States has implemented a variety of policy mechanisms to protect agricultural lands, and individual states have invested $5.5 billion in this protection; however, the conversion of prime farmland to development continues. Is farmland protection policy effective in maintaining viable agricultural landscapes? In this study, we developed a suite of indicators to measure the performance of state-funded agricultural conservation easement programs including a) land quality, b) cost, c) development risk, d) proportion of a state’s agricultural land protected, and e) contiguity of protected land. We then compared these indicators across 11 states and among three different easement program designs using regression analysis and landscape metrics. We found that state-funded easement programs do not necessarily perform better than easements that were not acquired with public funds. Furthermore, we found that program design may be an important factor when measuring program performance. We categorized these programs by the degree of centralized decision-making and found that decentralized programs protect lands with at least three times higher quality, that are almost twice as valuable, and with at least 1.5 times greater development risk than centralized and collaborative programs. At the landscape level, easements in states with decentralized programs have at least 1.3 times greater contiguity compared to centralized and collaborative programs though they were also associated with the lowest proportion of the state’s agricultural land base under protection at 0.8%. Overall, our analysis revealed that irrespective of program design, there may be trade-offs between the quantity, quality, and cost of the lands protected. Further research is needed to fully investigate how farmland protection policies in general, and program design specifically, affect society’s ability to maintain a viable agricultural land base.
abstract_zh: 美国已实施多种政策机制以保护农业用地，各州为此已投入55亿美元；然而，优质农田转为开发用地的现象仍在持续。农田保护政策能否有效维持可持续的农业景观？在本研究中，我们构建了一套指标，用以衡量州财政资助的农业保护地役权（conservation easement）计划的绩效，包括：a）土地质量，b）成本，c）开发风险，d）受保护的农业用地占全州农业用地的比例，以及e）受保护土地的连片程度。随后，我们利用回归分析和景观指标，比较了11个州及三种不同地役权计划设计下的这些指标。我们发现，州财政资助的地役权计划的绩效并不一定优于未使用公共资金获取的地役权。此外，我们发现，计划设计可能是衡量计划绩效的一个重要因素。我们按决策集中程度对这些计划进行了分类，发现分权式计划保护的土地质量至少高出三倍，价值几乎高出一倍，开发风险至少比集中式和协作式计划高出1.5倍。在景观层面，分权式计划所在州的地役权连片程度至少比集中式和协作式计划高出1.3倍，尽管这些计划也对应着全州农业用地基础中受保护比例最低的情况，仅为0.8%。总体而言，我们的分析表明，无论计划设计如何，在受保护土地的数量、质量和成本之间可能存在权衡取舍。要充分探究农田保护政策（尤其是计划设计）如何影响社会维持可持续农业用地基础的能力，还需要进一步研究。

title: Environmental Shocks and Agriculture: Implications of Floods on Labor Market Outcomes
abstract: Floods often displace people and exacerbate their access to finance, affecting the livelihood of daily wage workers in least-developed countries. In August 2017, Nepal experienced the heaviest rainfall in more than 60 years, severely flooding about 80 percent of the land in the southern part of the country. Using the TWFE approach and an event study design, we evaluate the impact of severe flooding on the wages of agricultural workers. We show that the 2017 floods resulted in a 10-11 percent decrease in cash wages among agricultural households while in-kind wages of agricultural laborers increased significantly after the floods, implying that in-kind wages helped mitigate the adverse effects of floods on cash wages. We investigate changes in assistance, loan-seeking behavior, loan repayment, and collection behavior as a mechanism leading to the risk-mitigating behavior by farmers.
abstract_zh: 洪水往往使人们流离失所，并加剧其获取金融服务的困难，从而影响最不发达国家日薪工人的生计。2017年8月，尼泊尔经历了60多年来最强的降雨，南部约80%的土地遭受严重洪涝。利用双向固定效应（TWFE）方法和事件研究设计，我们评估了严重洪水对农业工人工资的影响。我们表明，2017年洪水导致农业家庭的现金工资下降了10%至11%，而洪水之后，农业劳动者的实物工资显著增加，这表明实物工资有助于缓解洪水对现金工资的不利影响。我们考察了援助、借贷寻求行为、贷款偿还和催收行为的变化，作为农民风险缓解行为的机制。

title: Can Solar Photovoltaic Poverty Alleviation Policies Reduce Carbon Emissions and Increase Income in China?
abstract: China implemented a solar photovoltaic (PV) poverty alleviation (PVPA) policy of building nearly 0.24 million PVPA power plants in 2014-2020 to fight poverty. However, our current knowledge of its effects, encompassing not only primary poverty alleviation but also secondary objectives such as carbon emission-reduction, remains comparatively constrained. Here, we present a comprehensive assessment of the emission-reducing and income-increasing effects of the PVPA policy using estimated carbon emission factors and a staggered difference-in-difference model based on integrated data from almost all actual PVPA plants in China. Our analysis revealed the co-benefits of emission-reduction and poverty alleviation, with PVPA policy boosting villagers' per capita net income by 2-3% in villages with PV plants. A nonlinear, inverted U-shaped relationship between income and PVPA plant investment was identified with a $2.21 million inflection point. Spatial heterogeneity was observed in the income-increasing effect, with centralized village-level plants proving more effective than rooftop household plants. China's PVPA plants reduced carbon emissions by nearly 3% in 2020 and are projected to generate 774 billion kW h of electricity by 2045, mitigating 715.75 million tons of carbon emissions. The findings from this research offer insights for optimizing antipoverty and climate change policies to facilitate sustainable development goal achievement in China and other developing nations.
abstract_zh: 中国在2014年至2020年间实施了太阳能光伏扶贫（PVPA）政策，建设了近24万座光伏扶贫电站，以对抗贫困。然而，我们目前对其效果的认识，即不仅包括主要的扶贫效果，还包括减排等次要目标，仍然相对有限。在此，我们运用估算的碳排放因子，以及基于中国几乎所有实际光伏扶贫电站综合数据的交错双重差分模型，对该政策的减排与增收效应进行了全面评估。我们的分析揭示了减排与扶贫的协同效益：光伏扶贫政策使有光伏电站的村庄村民人均纯收入提高了2%至3%。我们识别出收入与光伏扶贫电站投资之间存在非线性的倒U形关系，拐点为221万美元。增收效应存在空间异质性，集中式村级电站比屋顶式家庭电站更为有效。中国的光伏扶贫电站在2020年使碳排放减少了近3%，并预计到2045年将发电7740亿千瓦时，减少7.1575亿吨碳排放。本研究的发现，可为优化扶贫与气候变化政策提供启示，以助力中国及其他发展中国家实现可持续发展目标。

title: Challenges in Water and Sanitation Services: Do Natural Disasters Make Matters Worse?
abstract: This article exploits a plausibly exogenous variation in peak ground acceleration to evaluate the impact of the 2015 earthquake on water and sanitation services among affected households in Nepal. Estimates from a difference‐in‐differences research design show that the severity of the earthquake is associated with a 9.4 percentage point decline in the likelihood of washing hands, a 6.63 percentage point decline in the likelihood of using water filters and an 18.16 percentage point decline in the likelihood of using flush to a piped sewer system. These negative effects of seismic shocks on binary indicators of water treatment and toilet services continue to persist even in earthquake‐affected districts where aid for water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) services was allocated for disbursement. While prospects of leakage in aid distribution across different levels of governance cannot be empirically tested, findings indicate that effective implementation of WASH‐related aid can partially mitigate disaster‐induced adverse outcomes related to water treatment and toilet services.
abstract_zh: 本文利用峰值地面加速度的一种看似外生的变化，评估2015年地震对尼泊尔受灾家庭水和卫生服务的影响。双重差分研究设计的估计显示，地震的严重程度与洗手可能性下降9.4个百分点、使用水过滤器的可能性下降6.63个百分点、使用接入管道下水道的冲水厕所的可能性下降18.16个百分点相关。地震冲击对水处理和厕所服务的二元指标产生的这些负面影响，即使在已拨付水、卫生与个人卫生（WASH）服务援助的地震受灾地区，仍然持续存在。尽管无法从实证上检验援助分配在不同治理层级间存在漏损的可能性，但研究结果表明，有效实施与WASH相关的援助，能够部分缓解灾害所引发的水处理和厕所服务方面的不利后果。

title: Shaking Things Up: Do Seismic Shocks Affect Energy Choices?
Spillover Effects of Natural Disasters on Human Capital
venue: Behavioral Economics and the Environment: A Research Companion
abstract: The 1988 earthquake in Nepal took 721 lives, demolished over 105,000 buildings, and affected almost half a million people. We evaluate the long-term impact of an older sibling’s exposure to the 1988 earthquake during infancy on the human capital of younger siblings born at least three years after the event. Using the quasi-random spatial and temporal nature of ground tremors, we show that the negative effect of the earthquake on grades of schooling is twice as large among the younger siblings compared to that among the older siblings who were directly exposed to the earthquake. We find that the younger siblings of earthquake-affected infants born in areas of high seismic intensity are 29.07% less likely to complete middle school, 36.52% less likely to complete high school and attain approximately 1.74 grades of schooling less. Together, these results indicate that the economic impact of a natural disaster that ignores these spillovers on younger siblings underestimates the cost of human capital associated with large earthquakes in a developing country setting.
abstract_zh: 1988年尼泊尔地震夺走了721人的生命，摧毁了超过10.5万栋建筑，并影响了将近50万人。我们评估了一个年长的兄姐在婴儿期遭遇1988年地震的长期影响，对象是至少在该事件发生三年后出生的年幼兄弟姐妹的人力资本。利用地面震动在空间和时间上的准随机性，我们表明，地震对年幼兄弟姐妹的受教育年限的负面影响，是对直接受地震影响的年长兄弟姐妹影响的两倍。我们发现，在地震中受影响的婴儿在高地震烈度地区出生的年幼兄弟姐妹，完成初中教育的可能性低29.07%，完成高中教育的可能性低36.52%，并且受教育年限平均少约1.74年。这些结果共同表明，若忽视对年幼兄弟姐妹的溢出效应，仅考察自然灾害的经济影响，将低估发展中国家大地震所造成的人力资本成本。

Environmental Disasters and Property Values: Evidence from Nepal's Forest Fires
abstract: This article uses satellite data on real-time active fire locations to evaluate the effect of forest fires on property values in Nepal. Results show that an additional unit increase in fire radiative power from last month’s forest fires causes a 0.61% decrease in residential property values. Property values decline by 4.48% for every additional unit increase in the number of forest fire incidents over the past year. These estimates suggest that policy makers should prioritize wildfire-risk awareness and fire-prevention programs in areas with higher levels of declined property values associated with recurring forest fire incidents.
abstract_zh: 本文利用实时活跃火点的卫星数据，评估森林火灾对尼泊尔房产价值的影响。结果显示，上个月森林火灾的火辐射功率每增加一个单位，住宅房产价值就会下降0.61%。过去一年中森林火灾事件数量每增加一个单位，房产价值下降4.48%。这些估计表明，政策制定者应当优先在那些因反复发生森林火灾而导致房产价值下降较多的地区，加强野火风险意识教育和防火计划。

Environmental Externalities from Agriculture: Evidence from Water Quality in the United States
abstract: Agricultural fertilizer use is widely acknowledged to be a leading cause of water pollution. Yet, no national estimates exist on the effect of fertilizer application on concentrations of agricultural pollutants in US watersheds. This paper employs a watershed‐level panel data on nitrogen and phosphorus pollution readings to examine the impact of fertilizer use on US water quality over a fifty‐five‐year time period from 1951 to 2005. Findings show that a 10% increase in the use of nitrogen and phosphorus fertilizers leads to a 1.52% increase in the concentration of nitrogen and a 1.37% increase in the concentration of phosphorus across watersheds. Results also indicate that there exists heterogeneity in nutrient pollution elasticity estimates across eighteen US water resource regions, ranging from 0.082 to 0.733 in the case of nitrogen and from 0.036 to 0.475 in the case of phosphorus. Combining our results with prior hydrology‐based studies, we find that a 100% increase in the use of nitrogen fertilizers in the Lower Mississippi water resource region expands the size of the hypoxic zone in the Gulf of Mexico by roughly 3,389 square miles, equivalent to about two‐fifths of the estimated size of the dead zone in the Gulf of Mexico.
abstract_zh: 农业化肥施用被广泛认为是水污染的主要成因。然而，目前尚无关于化肥施用对美国流域农业污染物浓度影响的全国性估计。本文利用流域层面的氮、磷污染监测面板数据，考察了1951至2005年这五十五年间化肥施用对美国水质的影响。研究发现，氮肥和磷肥用量每增加10%，流域内氮浓度增加1.52%，磷浓度增加1.37%。结果还显示，美国十八个水资源区之间的营养物污染弹性存在异质性：氮的弹性估计值在0.082至0.733之间，磷的弹性估计值在0.036至0.475之间。结合以往基于水文学的研究，我们发现，密西西比河下游水资源区的氮肥用量每增加100%，将使墨西哥湾缺氧区的面积扩大约3,389平方英里，相当于墨西哥湾“死区”估计面积的约五分之二。
